finding: The frozen G-E2 gate is underpowered: its minimum detectable effect exceeds its own +5 F1 threshold
status: measured from artifacts; the gate is NOT changed by this finding

evidence.clean_pool: 0.5b k=5, all six arms kernel-produced, 60 paired receipts
evidence.read: The 95% interval spans roughly -3.8 to +6.0 F1. A true +5 F1 effect and a true zero effect are both inside it, so at n=60 this design cannot tell them apart.

why_it_is_worse_than_it_looks.seed_slices_overlap: CORD validation is 100 rows and each seed evaluates shuffled[k:k+20], so the 60 draws at k=5 cover only 50 DISTINCT receipts (pairwise overlaps 4/4/3). Pooling treats them as 60 independent observations, so the interval above is optimistic and the true MDE is worse than 0.069.
why_it_is_worse_than_it_looks.ceiling_on_this_split: Even devoting the entire validation split to evaluation gives at most 100-k ~= 90 distinct receipts, still short of the ~115 the observed spread requires. The frozen gate is therefore NOT resolvable on the current validation split at any eval_n.
why_it_is_worse_than_it_looks.k10_is_noisier_still: At k=10 the per-receipt spread is roughly double k=5's (sd 0.35-0.45 vs 0.16-0.19), driven by invalid-JSON receipts scoring 0. The k=10 pool is additionally contaminated (seed 1 local, seed 3 kernel) and its interval is reported non-authoritative.

what_this_does_NOT_mean: It does not mean adaptation fails. It means this measurement cannot resolve a +5 F1 effect either way.
It does not invalidate the running 1.5B and 4B rungs. Their point estimates are the frozen deliverable and remain worth having.

It does not license changing eval_n, POOL_SAMPLES, seeds or the threshold mid-flight. The preregistration is frozen; altering it while runs are in progress is exactly the failure mode the freeze exists to prevent.

consequences_for_claims.binding_rule: When a rung's number lands, it is quoted as a point estimate WITH its interval, never as a bare 'G-E2 PASSED'. A pass whose interval includes zero is a suggestive result, not a measured mechanism, and must be described that way in every material derived from it.
consequences_for_claims.why_this_matters_commercially: The wedge's pitch is 'measured mechanism, not a bet'. A +5 F1 headline that a technical diligence pass can widen to 'straddles zero' is worse than no headline, because it costs credibility on every other number in the package.

proposed_amendment_do_not_apply_yet.when: only after the currently frozen 1.5B and 4B rungs complete and are reported as preregistered
proposed_amendment_do_not_apply_yet.change: draw evaluation receipts from the 800-row CORD-v2 TRAIN split, held out from adaptation, instead of the 100-row validation split; raise eval_n until distinct paired receipts exceed the measured requirement (~115 at k=5 spread, more at k=10)
proposed_amendment_do_not_apply_yet.cost: generation dominates arm cost (89%, memprobe 2026-08-11), so eval_n scales arm wall-clock almost linearly
proposed_amendment_do_not_apply_yet.discipline: this is a preregistration AMENDMENT: it must be dated, written into Addendum A as a numbered revision, and every affected claim must state which version produced it
